text:
Mina: dropped an updated mock for the latency/heatmap panel. looking for quick takes on p95 emphasis, where the color scale lives, and how the timepicker should interact with sampling. figma: https://figma.com/file/updated-latency-mock (preview)

Raj: nice. high-level Q: should p95 be the most visually dominant line? worried it competes with the heatmap density bands.

Eli: make p95 the primary solid line, p50 can be thinner/dashed. that keeps it readable without overpowering the heatmap.

Sam: a11y: use a deuteranopia-safe palette for the heatmap. ensure the p95 line has a pattern/weight difference (not just color). legend items need keyboard focus and aria-labels.

Mina: what about legend placement? inline below the heatmap vs floating on hover?

Raj: inline-bottom is easier for quick scans and for keyboard discovery. floating tooltip is fine for deep-dive but loses discoverability.

DevQA: infra note: we can add an "x-sampled: 1" header and a sampling_rate value so UI can show exact badge text. also sampled p95 will be noisy — we should call that out in the copy.

Mina: proposed badge/copy: "Sampled view (est.)" with tooltip: "This panel shows sampled data. Totals and percentiles are estimates. Toggle sampling off to fetch full counts (higher cost)." any objections?

Sam: copy ok but make contrast check: badge bg needs >=4.5:1 to text. tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers (aria-describedby).

Eli: UX nit: when user changes time range, preserve sampling state and show a small pill near the timepicker: "Sampling: 10%  (approx)" — avoid modal interruptions.

Raj: wording nit: prefer "Sample rate" label next to the control, and in the pill: "Sampling: 10% (approx)". Tooltip for the control: "This view uses a subset of requests; numbers are estimated."

Mina: sketch of front-end config (for eng):
```
{
  "samplingEnabled": true,
  "samplingLabel": "Sample rate",
  "badgeText": "Sampled view (est.)",
  "timepickerPresets": ["15m","1h","6h","24h"],
  "heatmapColorScheme": "cb_safe",
  "legendPosition": "inline-bottom",
  "smoothingDefault": false
}
```

DevQA: two more things: 1) surface the sampling_rate from API so front-end can show exact percent, 2) include a boolean header when smoothing applied so we can repro UI vs backend differences.

Sam: keyboard accessibility checklist: sampling toggle tabbable, aria-pressed, explicit focus ring. pill should be reachable, and tooltip content must be linked via aria-describedby.

Mina: agree. I'll update the figma to use the cb_safe palette, move the legend inline-bottom, add the sampling pill mock, and write copy with the accessibility notes.

Raj: thumbs up from me. Eli?

Eli: :+1: update looks good. keep smoothing opt-in.

DevQA: will add API contract notes in the spec PR.

Mina: thanks team — will push iteration tonight and tag eng.
